elements.requirement: A payment or benefit means anything that would be general earnings from an employment if it were received by an employee for performing the duties of that employment.
elements.quote: anything that, if received by an employee for performing the duties of an employment, would be general earnings from the employment

elements.requirement: The amount of a payment or cash benefit is taken to be the amount received.
elements.quote: in the case of a payment or cash benefit, the amount received

elements.requirement: The amount of a non-cash benefit is taken to be the cash equivalent of that benefit.
elements.quote: in the case of a non-cash benefit, the cash equivalent of the benefit

elements.requirement: The cash equivalent of a non-cash benefit is taken to be the amount that would be general earnings if the benefit were general earnings from an employment.
elements.quote: the amount that would be general earnings if the benefit were general earnings from an employment

elements.requirement: For living accommodation, the cash equivalent is taken to be whichever is the greater of the amount that would be general earnings and the cash equivalent determined in accordance with section 398(2).
elements.quote: in the case of living accommodation, whichever is the greater of that amount and the cash equivalent determined in accordance with section 398(2)

elements.requirement: A payment or cash benefit is treated as received when payment is made of or on account of the payment or benefit.
elements.quote: in the case of a payment or cash benefit, when payment is made of or on account of the payment or benefit

elements.requirement: A non-cash benefit is treated as received when it would have been treated as received for the purposes of Chapter 4 or 5 of this Part (see section 19 or 32) if the worker had been an employee and the benefit had been provided by reason of the employment.
